format.name: Format template
format.desc: Text written into the task. Use {{time}} to write the current time, e.g. cancelled:: {{time}}.

taskFormat.name: Task field format
taskFormat.desc: Choose how timestamps are written: Dataview inline fields or Tasks emoji fields.

intercept.name: Interception trigger tag/text
intercept.desc: Only tasks containing this tag or text get timestamps written/removed and status transitions applied. Leave empty to handle all tasks.

alwaysWriteCreated.name: Always write created time
alwaysWriteCreated.desc: When enabled, clicking a task in any state adds the created timestamp if it is missing. Existing timestamps are never overwritten.

transitionScope.name: Transition scope
transitionScope.desc: Choose which tasks cycle through the custom states when their checkbox is clicked.

transitionTrigger.name: Transition trigger tag/text
transitionTrigger.desc: Only tasks containing this tag or text cycle through custom states.

suggestTrigger.name: Suggestion trigger character
suggestTrigger.desc: Show the created time suggestion after this character. Default is a space.

timeFormat.name: Time format
timeFormat.desc: Choose the timestamp format used for created, completion and cancelled times.

customTimeFormat.name: Custom time format
customTimeFormat.desc: Enter a moment.js format string. If invalid, the ISO format is used.

created.name: Write created time
created.desc: Add a created timestamp to new tasks, and fill it in when editing a task that has none.

done.name: Write completion time
done.desc: Add a completion timestamp when a task is completed, and remove it when it is uncompleted.

cancelled.name: Write cancelled time
cancelled.desc: Add a cancelled timestamp when a task is cancelled, and remove it when it is no longer cancelled.
